purpose: Convert a citizen's natural-language follow-up to an approved property answer into a safely scoped linked question or sub-investigation while preserving established context.
core_principle: FOLLOW-UP QUESTION → PRESERVE KNOWN CONTEXT → IDENTIFY NEW DIMENSION → MINIMUM NEW SCOPE → LINKED ROUTE
rules: Follow-up wording such as 'what about the mortgage?' retains the established property unless the citizen indicates another property.
A follow-up may inherit verified property identity, but not unsupported conclusions.
New legal issues are added only when the follow-up requires them.
A changed date is treated as a new temporal scope, not silently merged with the old one.
A new property reference creates an identity check rather than inheriting the old property.
Previously verified evidence may be reused only under the knowledge-reuse rules.
New evidence requirements are determined by the new question, not by convenience.
Compound follow-ups are split into linked subquestions when necessary.
The original answer remains immutable; follow-up work creates a linked investigation or subquestion.
A follow-up does not broaden scope beyond what the citizen actually asked.
hard_stops: Never silently switch to another property.
Never carry a prior legal conclusion into a different legal issue without analysis.
Never treat a related question as evidence of a property fact.
Never expand the date range merely because older or newer records exist.
Never mutate the original answer snapshot.
Never reuse stale evidence or procedure without freshness checks.
Never expose private case context merely because it is related.
